question: Should this broad Android composer-state consolidation proceed once exact-head Android CI and live owner-transition proof confirm that alias changes neither leak composer state nor relax send admission?
rationale: The patch intentionally rewires the owner boundary introduced by the recent Android fix; automated diff review cannot establish live device behavior across gateway, agent, and session transitions.

options.title: Require focused Android proof before merge
options.body: Run the exact-head Android suite and add redacted emulator or device evidence covering attachment/media ownership plus a send during an owner-alias transition.

options.title: Accept refactor risk with owner sign-off
options.body: A responsible owner may merge based on source and test review while explicitly accepting that live transition proof was not captured.

recommendation.title: Require focused Android proof before merge
recommendation.body: Run the exact-head Android suite and add redacted emulator or device evidence covering attachment/media ownership plus a send during an owner-alias transition.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged owner-state behavior whose lifecycle contract this refactor reorganizes.
